favourite.heading: Why Utah State can pull away
bullets: Playing at Utah State is worth 4.1 points — the league-wide home-field number, because a per-venue table was tested and could not be told apart from the home team’s own quality (+4.1 pts).

Utah State is the better football team by 2.0 points on opponent-adjusted results — but about 74% of that rating is still last season carried forward, and in a portal era last season is a different team (+2.0 pts).
Conference strength differs and the in-season sample is still thin, worth 1.0 points to Utah State (+1.0 pts).

underdog.heading: Why Troy can keep it close
bullets: The outcome range is 15.3 points wide at one sigma — p10 -15.7 to p90 +28.3 for Utah State, so a projection of +7.3 still produces results a long way either side of it.
It is early enough that both ratings still lean on preseason belief — it widens the outcome range by about 4%.
College ratings are built on twelve-game seasons against wildly uneven schedules; even a clean rating gap carries more estimation error than the number implies.
